column.name: description
column.value: INFORED monthly credit extract. One row per person-to-loan relationship (borrower + guarantors). Column order matches OrdenCamposInfored.

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'InfoRed'

update.column: WITH loan_base AS ( SELECT l.id AS loan_id, l.account_no AS Num_ptmo, l.client_id, l.disbursedon_date AS fec_otor, COALESCE(l.principal_amount, 0) AS monto, l.number_of_repayments AS plazo, COALESCE(l.total_outstanding_derived, 0) AS saldo, COALESCE(laa.total_overdue_derived, 0) AS mora, CASE WHEN l.repayment_period_frequency_enum = 2 AND COALESCE(l.repay_every, 1) = 1 THEN 5 WHEN l.repayment_period_frequency_enum = 1 AND COALESCE(l.repay_every, 1) = 2 THEN 6 WHEN l.repayment_period_frequency_enum = 1 AND COALESCE(l.repay_every, 1) = 1 THEN 7 ELSE 5 END AS forma_pag, CASE WHEN laa.overdue_since_date_derived IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(DATEDIFF('${endDate}', laa.overdue_since_date_derived), 0) END AS dias, /* ult_pag: actual last payment date (repayment txn), not schedule due date */ ( SELECT MAX(lt.transaction_date) FROM m_loan_transaction lt WHERE lt.loan_id = l.id AND lt.transaction_type_enum = 2 AND lt.is_reversed = 0 ) AS ult_pag, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_guarantor g WHERE g.loan_id = l.id AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.type_enum IN (1, 3) ) THEN 'FI' ELSE 'NA' END AS tipo_gar, COALESCE( l.fixed_emi_amount, ( SELECT ROUND( COALESCE(rs.principal_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.interest_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_amount, 0), 2 ) FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_id = l.id ORDER BY rs.installment ASC LIMIT 1 ), 0 ) AS valcuota, l.closedon_date AS fecha_can, l.expected_maturedon_date AS fecha_ven, l.number_of_repayments AS ncuotascre, CASE WHEN l.loan_status_id = 600 THEN 3 WHEN l.loan_status_id = 300 THEN 1 WHEN l.loan_status_id = 601 THEN 4 WHEN l.loan_status_id = 700 THEN 3 ELSE l.loan_status_id END AS estcredito FROM m_loan l JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = c.office_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging laa ON laa.loan_id = l.id WHERE l.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL AND l.disbursedon_date <= '${endDate}' AND ( l.loan_status_id = 300 OR ( l.closedon_date IS NOT NULL AND l.closedon_date >= '${startDate}' AND l.closedon_date <= '${endDate}' ) ) AND (${officeId} = -1 OR c.office_id = ${officeId}) AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') ), borrowers AS ( SELECT YEAR('${endDate}') AS `Año`, MONTH('${endDate}') AS mes, c.display_name AS nombre, 1 AS tipo_per, lb.Num_ptmo AS Num_ptmo, 'J2409111257NS' AS inst, DATE_FORMAT(lb.fec_otor, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fec_otor, ROUND(lb.monto, 2) AS monto, lb.plazo AS plazo, ROUND(lb.saldo, 2) AS saldo, ROUND(lb.mora, 2) AS mora, lb.forma_pag AS forma_pag, 1 AS tipo_rel, 'COM' AS linea_cre, lb.dias AS dias, DATE_FORMAT(lb.ult_pag, '%d/%m/%Y') AS ult_pag, lb.tipo_gar AS tipo_gar, 2 AS tipo_mon, ROUND(lb.valcuota, 2) AS valcuota, 5 AS dia, DATE_FORMAT(c.date_of_birth, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fechanac, TRIM(COALESCE( CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(dp.tipo_documento_identificacion, '')) LIKE '%NIT%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(dp.numero_documento_identificacion), '') END, ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = c.id AND UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%DUI%' LIMIT 1 ) )) AS dui, TRIM(COALESCE( CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(dp.tipo_documento_identificacion, '')) LIKE '%NIT%' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(dp.numero_documento_identificacion), '') ELSE NULL END, ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = c.id AND UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%NIT%' LIMIT 1 ) )) AS nit, DATE_FORMAT(lb.fecha_can, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fecha_can, DATE_FORMAT(lb.fecha_ven, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fecha_ven, lb.ncuotascre AS ncuotascre, 'A1' AS calif_act, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(dp.desc_actividad_economica), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dp.ocupacion_actividad_real), '') ) AS activi_eco, CASE WHEN gender.code_value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(gender.code_value), 1)) IN ('F', 'M') THEN UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(gender.code_value), 1)) WHEN UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%FEM%' OR UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%MUJ%' THEN 'F' WHEN UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%MAS%' OR UPPER(gender.code_value) LIKE '%HOM%' THEN 'M' ELSE NULL END AS sexo, lb.estcredito AS estcredito FROM loan_base lb JOIN m_client c ON c.id = lb.client_id LEFT JOIN credesal_client_datos_personales dp ON dp.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value gender ON gender.id = c.gender_cv_id ), guarantors AS ( SELECT YEAR('${endDate}') AS `Año`, MONTH('${endDate}') AS mes, CASE WHEN g.type_enum = 1 THEN gc.display_name ELSE TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(g.firstname, ''), ' ', COALESCE(g.lastname, ''))) END AS nombre, 1 AS tipo_per, lb.Num_ptmo AS Num_ptmo, 'J2409111257NS' AS inst, DATE_FORMAT(lb.fec_otor, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fec_otor, ROUND(lb.monto, 2) AS monto, lb.plazo AS plazo, ROUND(lb.saldo, 2) AS saldo, ROUND(lb.mora, 2) AS mora, lb.forma_pag AS forma_pag, 3 AS tipo_rel, 'COM' AS linea_cre, lb.dias AS dias, DATE_FORMAT(lb.ult_pag, '%d/%m/%Y') AS ult_pag, 'FI' AS tipo_gar, 2 AS tipo_mon, ROUND(lb.valcuota, 2) AS valcuota, 5 AS dia, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(gc.date_of_birth, g.dob), '%d/%m/%Y') AS fechanac, CASE WHEN g.type_enum = 1 THEN TRIM(COALESCE( CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(gdp.tipo_documento_identificacion, '')) LIKE '%NIT%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(gdp.numero_documento_identificacion), '') END, ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = gc.id AND UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%DUI%' LIMIT 1 ) )) ELSE NULL END AS dui, CASE WHEN g.type_enum = 1 THEN TRIM(COALESCE( CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(gdp.tipo_documento_identificacion, '')) LIKE '%NIT%' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(gdp.numero_documento_identificacion), '') ELSE NULL END, ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(ci.document_key), '') FROM m_client_identifier ci JOIN m_code_value idt ON idt.id = ci.document_type_id WHERE ci.client_id = gc.id AND UPPER(idt.code_value) LIKE '%NIT%' LIMIT 1 ) )) ELSE NULL END AS nit, DATE_FORMAT(lb.fecha_can, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fecha_can, DATE_FORMAT(lb.fecha_ven, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fecha_ven, lb.ncuotascre AS ncuotascre, 'A1' AS calif_act, CASE WHEN g.type_enum = 1 THEN COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(gdp.desc_actividad_economica), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(gdp.ocupacion_actividad_real), '') ) ELSE NULL END AS activi_eco, CASE WHEN g.type_enum <> 1 OR ggender.code_value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(ggender.code_value), 1)) IN ('F', 'M') THEN UPPER(LEFT(TRIM(ggender.code_value), 1)) WHEN UPPER(ggender.code_value) LIKE '%FEM%' OR UPPER(ggender.code_value) LIKE '%MUJ%' THEN 'F' WHEN UPPER(ggender.code_value) LIKE '%MAS%' OR UPPER(ggender.code_value) LIKE '%HOM%' THEN 'M' ELSE NULL END AS sexo, lb.estcredito AS estcredito FROM loan_base lb JOIN m_guarantor g ON g.loan_id = lb.loan_id AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.type_enum IN (1, 3) LEFT JOIN m_client gc ON g.type_enum = 1 AND gc.id = g.entity_id LEFT JOIN credesal_client_datos_personales gdp ON gdp.client_id = gc.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value ggender ON ggender.id = gc.gender_cv_id ) SELECT * FROM borrowers UNION ALL SELECT * FROM guarantors ORDER BY Num_ptmo, tipo_rel
